content:
All Cloud DNS logs are written to Cloud Logging. There is no separate charge from Cloud DNS
for this service. However, these logs can result in additional storage costs depending on the
size of the logs that are written and stored.
For calculation purposes, Cloud DNS writes approximately 5 MB of log data for processing
10,000 DNS queries.
For information about Cloud Logging pricing, see Pricing for Google Cloud Observability: Cloud
Logging (https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing).
